extraction.Name: James M. Biggins, Jr.
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded April 13, 1920, by D. A. Sinclair
extraction.Buyer: Lannan and wife mortgaged the land to James M. Biggins for #14000, due April 1, 1925; Biggins and wife conveyed the land by deed to James C. Laman for $24,800
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612794 issued December 29, 1917. Northwest quarter section 21, township 99, north of range. Receipt for patent signed April 6, 1920, by the allottee. On April 6, 1920, Lannan and wife mortgaged the land to James M. Biggins for #14000, due April 1, 1925. On April 9, 1920, Biggins and wife conveyed the land by deed to James C. Laman for $24,800.
